newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Plains fed cattle market slow at $69-feedlots.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Plains fed cattle market slow at $69-feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains fed cattle trade was slow at midday Friday, with light sales at $69.00 per cwt reported, steady with this week's top, feedlot sources said.

About 100 heifers sold in the Texas Panhandle/western Oklahoma area which will likely grade select or choice, USDA said. Bids early were light at $69.00 per cwt and mostly passed by owners asking $70.00 to $71.00, sources said.

There reportedly were some cattle left over on the week's showlists at a few feedlots. However, most showlists were depleted Tuesday and Wednesday amid active sales at $69, which was up $3.00 from last week's top price, they said.
